task: Risk of late delivery at payment approval, conditional on eventual delivery
limitations: Retrospective sample includes only orders eventually delivered; cancelled/undelivered orders require a different outcome definition.
Training and July selection exclude labels unknown at the cutoff; July validation is therefore a maturity-selected subset.
August is a single out-of-time test; no causal or online performance claim.
Probabilities are not calibrated on a separate sample. Precision/recall at 10% describe a retrospective capacity scenario, not an online threshold.
